description: Predict gender from a first name in a specific country (e.g., "US", "FR", "DE"). Returns gender, probability, and regional sample size.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE") to localize the prediction.

name.description: First name to predict gender for.

name: predict_gender_country

country.description: ISO country code used for region-specific prediction
